name: skills
description: Agent Skills for Google products and technologies
one_liner: A free library of instruction packs that teach an AI coding assistant how to correctly set up and use various Google Cloud tools.
buyer: A cloud consulting firm that bills clients for Google Cloud migrations and wants its AI assistants to get configurations right the first time instead of burning billable hours on trial-and-error.
business_use_cases: A Google Cloud reseller uses it internally to speed up client onboarding and cut wasted billable hours on config mistakes.
A training company builds a paid 'AI-ready Google Cloud' workshop or certification course around these skills.
An MSP offers an 'AI-assisted GCP cost and security audit' service, using the relevant skill modules as the engine.

money_ideas.idea: Paid training/certification course built on top of the skill set
Cloud consulting engagements that use it to deliver faster, cheaper

steal_this: It's free documentation and tooling from Google itself, not a product to resell as-is — the realistic weekend move is to package a narrow consulting offer (e.g. 'GCP cost audit in 3 days') around it, not to sell the skills themselves.
